  "B": asked for -8.000s, but its end cannot come back past 10.000 -- the largest shrink it can take is 6.000s
A shrink may only ever remove silence -- it never cuts into a region's contents, and never leaves a region shorter than one bar.

Padding and Headroom above are EXACT: every Tempo Anchor this project needs is already present, so the current bar grid is the one a run would plan against.

WHAT THIS CHECK CANNOT SEE
  - Padding measured against the grid the Tempo Anchors will create. Until they are written, Padding is computed against the grid as it stands now.
  - Whether writing the Tempo Anchors moves beat-attached material. That can only be detected after the write, and the run refuses if it happens.
  - Whether Padding would run a region into its neighbour once the anchors exist, which follows from the two above.

Nothing has been changed -- this action only reads.
